slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the production
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective, and Turn 1 also probed whether profit is the objective or a constraint, covering the core meaning of the slot.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time or unused capacity of the manufacturing, assembly, or inspection processes, nor about any cost-proportional weighting of a secondary objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation never reached a READY_TO_MODEL or final modeling state; instead the agent fell into repeating truncated, low-value questions about the Type A quantity, leaving the P1 idle-time objective slot unresolved.

summary: The agent recovered the core profit-maximization objective (P0) but never asked about the idle-time minimization objective (P1), and the interaction degenerated into repetitive/truncated questions without ever reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
